note.subject: governance
note.why_in_news: The Kerala High Court directed the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) to improve pilgrim infrastructure and grievance redressal mechanisms at Erumely.
note.fact_box: The Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) is the body responsible for managing the Sabarimala temple and associated pilgrimage sites. The court ordered the appointment of a Deputy Collector to oversee complaint resolution and infrastructure management.

prelims_pointers.text: Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB): A statutory body responsible for the administration of Sabarimala and related shrines.
Erumely: A significant pilgrimage site in the Pathanamthitta district of Kerala.
The court mandated the implementation of CCTV surveillance and a mobile booking app with UPI payment integration.

note.fact_box: Karnataka received 564.6 mm of rainfall against a normal of 831.8 mm. Bengaluru city recorded 313 mm (a -236 mm departure), while the HAL station recorded 434 mm.

note.subject: environment
note.why_in_news: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) reported that 2026 recorded the lowest monsoon rainfall in a decade due to a strengthening El Nino and a neutral Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD).
note.fact_box: India received 759.4 mm of rainfall between June and September 2026, which was 87% of the Long Period Average (LPA) of 868.6 mm. The deficit crossed the all-India drought threshold, with East and Northeast India recording their lowest seasonal rainfall since 1901.

prelims_pointers.text: India's 2026 monsoon rainfall was 759.4 mm, representing 87% of the 868.6 mm LPA.
El Nino is a climate pattern characterized by the warming of the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean.
The Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) remained neutral during the 2026 monsoon season.
East and Northeast India recorded 1,016.3 mm of rainfall in 2026, the lowest since 1901.
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) is the primary agency for monitoring and forecasting monsoon patterns in India.

note.mains_question: Analyze the impact of El Nino and the Indian Ocean Dipole on India's monsoon patterns and discuss strategies to mitigate drought-induced agricultural risks.
note.title: 2026 marks lowest monsoon in a decade as El Nino causes drought threshold deficit

note.subject: polity
note.why_in_news: The Election Commission of India directed Chief Electoral Officers to conduct a special drive to re-enroll eligible voters following the deletion of 13.3 crore names from voter lists.
note.fact_box: The Election Commission announced a special drive during its September 26 meeting to rectify voter list discrepancies. Booth Level Officers (BLOs) are tasked with house-to-house visits to identify and enroll eligible electors using Form 6 within a one-month timeframe.

prelims_pointers.text: Election Commission of India (ECI) is the constitutional body responsible for administering elections to Parliament and State Legislatures.
Approximately 13.3 crore names were deleted from voter lists leading to the current rectification drive.
Form 6 is the specific application form used for the enrollment of new voters in the electoral roll.
Chief Electoral Officers (CEOs) are the primary state-level authorities responsible for the conduct of elections in their respective States/UTs.

note.mains_question: Examine the challenges in maintaining an accurate and inclusive electoral roll in India and suggest measures to ensure universal suffrage.
note.title: EC directs officers to enroll eligible voters after 13.3 crore names deleted
